remarks: Springdale special!!! Perfect for commuters is this spacious well maintained clean 1BD condo on the top level of a very quiet complex in a super convenient location. Open floor plan eat-in kitchen/living room combo. Great size bedroom with an oversized closet and carpets just professionally cleaned in both BD and living room. Bathroom is partially updated and the floor and tub were just re-grouted. Great size coat/shoe closet by the condo entrance is also included. Walk to train, shops and restaurants, minutes to Darien and New Canaan, short drive to beaches and Downtown Stamford. Heat and hot water is included in rent!!! Common laundry on the ground level. Assigned parking spot #22 as well as separate great size storage room also included in rent. Landlord requires good credit. A definite must see!!!
